scope: Existing authored projection editing, image replacement, restricted v7 update transactions and exact preview on the existing uncommitted development tree

application.command: VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY=<temporary archive helper> VIENTO_MOBILE_STORE_BIN=<temporary mobile helper> VIENTO_GODOT_BIN=<cached Godot> npm run check -- --app-only

browser.command: VIENTO_GODOT_BIN=<cached Godot> VIENTO_PROJECTION_EDIT_OUTPUT=<new evidence directory> node scripts/tests/object-projection-edit-smoke.mjs

projectionEditIntegration.tools: Real Godot, native desktop archive and native mobile storage helper

nativeHelpers.command: CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<temporary target> cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example workspace-archive --example mobile-storage

coverage: Title and all typed configuration fields can be edited through the same three-language form; fixed identity, source, type, path and template snapshot.
Scalar-range rewriting preserves BOM/CRLF, unknown exact integers and unmodified lexical tokens; preview matches committed source.
A newly selected image appends a deduplicated binding; old images, author relations and extensions remain intact. Clearing an image changes use without deleting media.
World/object/source conflicts and lost-response reconciliation retain the draft; the same existing UUID alone never proves success.

Restricted v7 two-existing-file transactions guard unchanged metadata; no-op produces no journal. SIGKILL at publishing boundaries, interrupted recovery, registry conflicts and forged journals are checked.
A shared OC, sibling projections and scene source remain byte-identical; inherited build values update, explicit old-image overrides remain valid, stale plans are rejected.
Single-selection resource packages and Node/Rust/mobile full roundtrips preserve identities, bytes and build semantics.
Chrome and real Godot rebuild preserve actor UUIDs; updated player moves 80px while NPC remains unchanged.
limitations: No packaged Tauri window or Android device acceptance in this increment; browser HTTP and native storage helpers are separate checks.
Headless runtime logic checked; graphical runtime window and physical keyboard were not repeated.
No full Rust unit rerun: native source is unchanged; helper compilation and interoperability were exercised.
Template/source/path changes and multi-projection batch editing are outside this form.
Retained old image bindings remain dependencies and can enlarge selection packages; no resource deletion is performed.
No version bump, commit, push, package installation or actual-work data migration.
